title: The Derelict
summary: The ring drops you into the hangar of a dead alien ship. Bring it back to life just long enough to leave.

hangar.name: Wrecked Hangar
hangar.description: A huge hangar lit only by the ring you came through, already fading. Twisted metal everywhere. The air is cold and smells of dust. In the north wall, a jammed hatch.

descriptionWhen.text: The hatch hangs open, bent where you forced it.

north.description: A heavy hatch, its edge buckled. It is stuck a finger's width open.
north.lockedMessage: The hatch is jammed. If only you had something to lever it open.

corridor.name: Main Corridor
corridor.description: A long corridor with ribbed walls. Faint red emergency strips glow along the floor. A scorched panel hangs off the wall. Doors lead west and east; at the far north end, a sealed bulkhead.

descriptionWhen.text: Lights flicker on overhead. The bulkhead to the north has slid open.

west.description: A door marked with a symbol like a sleeping figure.

east.description: Beyond this door, total darkness. You hear a low hum.
east.lockedMessage: You take two steps into the pitch-black room, bang your shin on something sharp, and retreat. You need light.

north.description: A massive bulkhead marked with the symbol of an eye. No power reaches it.
north.lockedMessage: The bulkhead doesn't move. The ship has no power.

quarters.name: Crew Quarters
quarters.description: Rows of empty bunks, sized for beings taller than you. Personal belongings float in the dust as if left in a hurry.

engine.name: Engine Room
engine.description: The heart of the ship: a tall reactor column, cold and silent. A big red valve sticks out of a pipe beside it. A ladder leads down.

descriptionWhen.text: A new fuse glows in the reactor's base.
The reactor hums with blue light.

down.description: A ladder into the cargo hold.

cargo.name: Cargo Hold
cargo.description: Crates stacked to the ceiling, many smashed open. Your lamp throws long shadows.

up.description: The ladder back up to the engine room.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.description: A dome of glass looking out onto a field of stars. In the centre, the helm: a ring of glowing controls. To the side, a small round door labelled with the symbol of a seed: the escape pod.

descriptionWhen.text: The escape pod door stands open, its launch lights blinking green.

pod.description: A pod just big enough for one. Its door is locked from the helm.
pod.lockedMessage: The pod door is sealed. It must be released from the helm.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A length of alien metal, bent at one end. A perfect lever.

lamp.name: Dead Lamp
lamp.description: A hand lamp of alien design. Its battery slot is empty.

lit_lamp.name: Lit Lamp
lit_lamp.description: The lamp shines a strong white beam.

hatch.name: Jammed Hatch
hatch.description: A heavy hatch, stuck a finger's width open. Something flat could fit in the gap.

panel.name: Scorched Panel
panel.description: A wall panel burned black. Through the soot you read, in the ship's pictograms: a drop of water, then a lightning bolt, then the reactor. Coolant first, then the fuse... or the other way round? The middle is burned away.

battery.name: Power Cell
battery.description: A small glowing cylinder, still charged. It looks like it fits a hand lamp.

journal.name: Crew Journal
journal.description: The last entry, in the ship's pictograms: "Fuse blown. Spare fuses are in the cargo hold. Remember: coolant BEFORE ignition, or the reactor will shut itself down."

bunks.name: Bunks
bunks.description: Long, narrow and empty. Nobody has slept here in a very long time.
bunks.fixedMessage: They are bolted to the floor.

reactor.name: Reactor Column
reactor.description: A column of crystal and metal reaching to the ceiling. At its base, a scorched fuse socket and an ignition switch.

valve.name: Coolant Valve
valve.description: A big red wheel on a pipe marked with the drop-of-water symbol.

fuse.name: Spare Fuse
fuse.description: A thick crystal fuse, still in its packing.

crates.name: Crates
crates.description: Mostly smashed and empty. Stencilled on them: the same lightning-bolt symbol as the reactor's fuse socket.
crates.fixedMessage: Far too heavy, and mostly empty anyway.

helm.name: Helm
helm.description: A ring of controls around a central sphere. One control shows the seed symbol of the escape pod.
helm.fixedMessage: It is part of the bridge.

chair.name: Captain's Chair
chair.description: A tall chair facing the stars. Whoever sat here left a very long time ago.
chair.fixedMessage: It's bolted down. And you shouldn't sit in the captain's chair.

rules.message: You jam the crowbar into the gap and heave. With a shriek of metal, the hatch swings open.
The cell clicks into the lamp. A strong white beam cuts through the dark.
You sweep the beam around. Dust, shadows, and nothing else you didn't already know.
You heave the wheel round. Coolant gurgles through the pipes around the reactor.
You slot the spare fuse into the socket. It lights up, waiting.
You flip the ignition. The reactor roars, then settles into a deep hum. All over the ship, lights come on and doors unlock.
You flip the ignition. Nothing. The fuse socket is burned out.
You flip the ignition. The reactor flares, alarms scream, and it shuts itself down in a cloud of steam. Something must cool it first.
You press the seed symbol. A voice speaks in a language you don't know, and the escape pod door hisses open.
You flip back through the pages. Diagrams of the reactor, a list of crew, and a drawing of a ring just like yours.
